title: Vietnamese Hangover Cure Soup
description: A spicy and comforting soup to help alleviate hangover symptoms. This recipe combines the flavors of Vietnam with the soothing effects of kale.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced gio and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped kale, hangover, cha, and furikake. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and soy sauce.
Bring the soup to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional kale if desired.
